resources.string: Wait for Wi-Fi before uploading selected files or connected folders to any source. Local file copies work offline. Automatic folder uploads also require an unmetered connection.
Could not update upload settings. Try again.
Choose where to save these photos and videos. Originals stay where they are.
No writable sources are available. Configure an Immich key with upload access or a writable Local Sticker folder.
Adds existing files and future additions using an unmetered connection. Android checks about every six hours. Originals are kept.
Choose or reselect a writable collection in Source settings to receive shared media. Existing collections remain indexed in place.
This source does not currently offer a writable destination. Its browsing settings are available below.
Adding selected media. Open to view progress.
Finishes the current file, clears other unfinished imports and pauses folder imports. Originals and completed imports are kept. Resume whenever you want to check connected folders again.
Stops future imports and cancels pending items from this folder. Original files and completed uploads are kept.
Upload access was refused. Check the API key and destination permissions in Source settings.
The source configuration changed. Reconnect this folder to confirm its destination.
Folder access is unavailable. Check its permission in Source settings.
A file changed or is no longer available. Check the folder again to discover its current version.
Not enough space to prepare this media.
The destination does not support one of these media formats.
This file already exists in the destination’s trash. Restore it there before importing again.
The transfer could not finish. Temporary failures retry with increasing delays, up to five attempts.
An item needs attention. Completed imports are kept; retry only retries unfinished items.
